standard_prerequisites.name: The structure of an \mathcal{O}_X-module on the kernel of a surjection of sheaves of rings with square zero kernel, given by multiplication with a lift of the scalar
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Recalled inside the counted proof at source lines 5250-5255
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes sense of the sum of a section and a derivation as a map into the thickening.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Leibniz rule and the module structure on the kernel, used to rearrange the cross terms of the product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 5256-5266
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that a section plus a derivation is again a ring homomorphism, and dually for the uniqueness.

core_obligations: Recall the module structure: the proof recalls that the kernel of the surjection carries the structure of a module over the structure sheaf by multiplication with a lift, and that the section itself supplies such a lift (proof lines 5250-5255)

Multiplicativity: the proof computes the product of a section plus a derivation on a product of local sections and, using the square zero property and the Leibniz rule, rearranges the four terms into a product of the two images, so that the sum is a ring homomorphism (proof lines 5256-5263)
Compatibility: the same computation shows the compatibility with the map of sheaves of rings, because the extra term is a derivation over the base (proof lines 5264-5266)
Uniqueness: for an arbitrary section the difference with the given one is shown to be a derivation, which is recorded as a routine verification (proof lines 5266-5267)
proof_roadmap: 先说明 I 的 O_X-模结构由 hτ = h̃τ 给出（h̃ 是 h 在 A 中的提升），而截面 s 本身可作提升。
用平方零与 Leibniz 法则计算 (s+D)(ab) = s(ab) + aD(b) + D(a)b = (s(a)+D(a))(s(b)+D(b))，同样地 s+D 与基环相容；反之 s' 与 s 之差是导子。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement describes the sections of a surjection of sheaves of algebras with square zero kernel: adding a derivation to a section gives another section, and every section arises uniquely this way (author lemma at source lines 5224-5247, label lemma-double-structure-gives-derivation). The proof (source lines 5249-5268) recalls the module structure on the square zero kernel supplied by a lift, performs the four term computation for the product of a section plus a derivation using square zero and the Leibniz rule, and notes that the same computation gives compatibility with the base (proof lines 5256-5266); the converse is the difference of two sections and is recorded as a routine verification. The displayed computation is the content. H2.
